results.description:
"A Masterpiece of Terror – Up There With the Horror Greats..."

A woman is dead – and now, a second victim has been discovered.

Semi-retired federal agent, Timothy Grey, is called in to investigate; but has this bloodthirsty killer been waiting for him the entire time?

Lives are at stake. Tim must face the demons of his past and follow the killer's clues in order to beat them at their wicked game of blood and torture if he has any chance of learning their true identity.

Feeling under pressure in a town that he is unfamiliar with, is there anybody he can trust?

Time is against the once-great detective as he is put to the ultimate test. Will he be able to triumph over evil? And at what cost?

Alex James Eccleston embarks on his most ambitious novel yet in this disturbing, spine-chilling detective mystery...
